explicit: no finger point, head shake, wink, smirk, raised-brow performance, theatrical surprise, cut, zoom, caption, title, logo, music, extra person or object; and follow the audio at original speed, do not stretch speech to fill the clip

the_real_question_this_raises: This is a different format from what EP009's Shorts are built as, not just a different angle. Wednesday is 78 percent presenter with two photographic cutaways and no designed screens. EP009's four Shorts are 44 percent presenter with designed schematic screens carrying the mechanism. Changing the angle is cheap and I can do it now. Changing the format would retire most of the screens work built this week and would need the beat assignment reopened.
